h1: The 6 Best Murphy Bed Cabinets for Studio Apartments of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Studio Murphy Bed Cabinets: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six assembled queen Murphy bed cabinets for studio apartments, compared on storage, charging, lighting, finish and lift.
mainKeyword: murphy bed cabinet for studio apartment
summary: The LUXOAK Queen Murphy Cabinet Bed is the best Murphy bed cabinet for a studio: built-in storage compartments, a charging station and an assembled cabinet design in the $200 to $500 range. The AMERLIFE mirrors its features, the Yoobure adds a rattan finish, and the Hlivelood models add LED lights and gas struts at $500+.
intro: Studio renters fixate on the bed and forget the room it leaves behind. A Murphy cabinet bed folds up to look like a wardrobe, but its folded depth and the clearance it needs to swing down can eat more floor than a plain frame if you do not plan the layout. The cabinet itself is the easy part. The wall, the ceiling and where you put a desk are not.

We reviewed eight Murphy bed listings and set aside two bare hardware kits, since a kit is not a finished cabinet. The six that remain are assembled queen-size cabinets, ranked on spec sheets for storage, charging, lift mechanism, lighting and finish. None of them includes a desk, so any plan for a studio needs one added separately.

products.name: LUXOAK Queen Murphy Cabinet Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: Storage compartments and a charging station in one assembled queen cabinet.
products.description:
The LUXOAK is a queen Murphy cabinet bed with built-in storage compartments and a charging station. It is listed as an assembled cabinet design, which spares you from sourcing and building a frame. It sells in the $200 to $500 range. Storage is what a studio lacks most, and compartments in the cabinet replace a dresser, which frees floor you would otherwise lose.

It ranks first because it leads on compartments among the assembled cabinets. It sits in the mid price range with the AMERLIFE, so the choice between them comes down to the layout of the storage. Against the Hlivelood, it costs less and trades lighting for storage and charging.

Best for a renter who wants the bed to double as a wardrobe wall. The caveat is that it does not include a desk and needs open floor to swing down. Skip it if you need a built-in desk.
products.idealFor: Studio renters who want maximum storage in one piece.

products.name: AMERLIFE Queen Murphy Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: Nearly the same feature list as the LUXOAK from a different maker.
products.description:
The AMERLIFE is a queen Murphy bed with built-in storage compartments and a charging station, in an assembled cabinet design. Its listed feature set mirrors the LUXOAK, and it sells in the $200 to $500 range. Matching specs mean your decision turns on delivered dimensions, finish and which maker's wall fixings you trust.

It ranks second because nothing in the listing separates it from the LUXOAK, so it takes the runner-up spot as a like-for-like option. Compare delivered dimensions and finish before choosing, since those are the real differences. Against the Yoobure, it lists general compartments instead of drawers.

A good pick if the LUXOAK is unavailable or if you prefer its look. The caveat is that it is hard to tell apart on paper, and a separate desk is part of the plan. Skip it if you want a distinctive style or lighting.
products.idealFor: Renters wanting a LUXOAK-style cabinet from another brand.
products.skipIf: You want a distinctive style or lighting.

products.name: Yoobure Queen Murphy Bed with Charging Station, Rattan Cabinet Bed with Storage Drawers
products.verdict: A rattan-finish cabinet bed with drawers and a charging station.
products.description:
The Yoobure is a queen foldable platform bed in a rattan cabinet finish, with storage drawers and a built-in charging station. It sells in the $200 to $500 range. Drawers pull out into the room, giving you clean access to socks and linens without opening a hinged door, though they hold less than open compartments.

It ranks third because the LUXOAK and AMERLIFE list more general storage, while this one trades some of that for a distinctive look. The rattan finish suits a boho or coastal studio. Against the LIVAUVEAD, it adds drawers at the same price range.

Choose it for a studio where the cabinet is a visible design feature. The caveat is less storage volume than the first two. Skip it if you want maximum storage volume.
products.idealFor: Studios with a boho or coastal look.

products.name: LIVAUVEAD Farmhouse Queen Size Murphy Bed with Charging Station, White
products.verdict: A farmhouse white cabinet bed with basic charging at the lowest assembled price.
products.description:
The LIVAUVEAD is a queen Murphy bed in a farmhouse white finish with a built-in charging station, built as an assembled cabinet. Storage compartments are not listed. It sells in the $200 to $500 range. White cabinetry reflects light, which helps a small studio feel less boxed in.

It ranks fourth because it drops the storage the top two include, which is the main way a cabinet bed earns space in a studio. In exchange it is the lowest-priced assembled option, still in the mid price range. Against the Hlivelood, it costs less but lacks lights and gas struts.

A fit for renters who want a bed that folds away and looks good in white. The caveat is the basic feature set. Skip it if the folded cabinet must double as a wardrobe.
products.idealFor: Budget-focused renters wanting a white cabinet.

products.name: Hlivelood Queen Size Murphy Bed with 2 LED Lights, Rustic White
products.verdict: A gas strut lift and two LED lights in a rustic white finish.
products.description:
This Hlivelood queen Murphy bed has two built-in LED lights, a gas strut mechanism and a rustic white finish. It sells at $500+. Gas struts assist the lift so folding the bed takes less effort, which matters because a Murphy bed gets folded every morning. LED lights give evening light without a bedside lamp.

It ranks fifth because it sits in the highest price range yet lists no storage or charging, so you pay for lighting and lift feel. It costs a little less than the brown version of the same design. Against the LUXOAK, it offers lights and struts but no compartments or charging.

Pick it for a studio where evening lighting from the cabinet matters. The caveat is the price and the missing storage. If storage or charging is the priority, the LUXOAK is better value.

products.name: Hlivelood Queen Size Murphy Bed with 2 LED Lights, Brown
products.verdict: The same lit gas strut design in a brown finish at a higher price.
products.description:
The brown Hlivelood is the same queen Murphy design as the white one, with two LED lights and a gas strut lift. It sells at $500+. A dark finish hides scuffs better than white in a high-traffic studio and suits wood-toned rooms.

It ranks last because it costs more than the rustic white version for the same listed features. If you prefer a darker cabinet the premium is the cost of color. Against the LUXOAK, it also lacks storage and charging, so the extra spend buys looks and lighting only.

Choose it only if brown suits your studio better than white. The caveat is that nothing in the listing justifies the price gap. Otherwise buy the rustic white version and save, or skip it if you are indifferent to finish color.
products.idealFor: Studios wanting a darker lit cabinet.
products.skipIf: You are indifferent to finish color.

whatMatters.detail: A Murphy bed folds into a cabinet, but it needs open floor to swing down when in use. That clearance is often larger than shoppers expect and can block a doorway or desk. Measure the room from the wall to the nearest obstacle and compare with the listing dimensions, including the folded depth. Leave extra room for a doorway and a desk chair.

Cabinet beds that include compartments or drawers replace a dresser, saving floor space. Without them you need separate storage. Look for the words compartments or drawers in the title or bullet points. The LUXOAK and AMERLIFE list compartments, the Yoobure drawers, and the Hlivelood and LIVAUVEAD list none.

Gas struts or pistons assist the lift so the bed rises and lowers with less effort. Weak assistance makes folding a daily chore. Check whether the listing names gas struts, as the Hlivelood does. Most others do not describe the mechanism, so ask the seller how it works. A slow, smooth lift protects your fingers and the cabinet.

Folded height, ceiling clearance and a stable wall matter in rentals. Check the listing for assembled height and whether the cabinet needs wall anchoring, and confirm your lease allows it. A cabinet that cannot be anchored in a studio wall is a poor fit, and a stud in the right place decides whether anchoring works.

A built-in charging station keeps a phone reachable without an extra table, and LED lights act as bedside lighting. Both are small but used daily. Check which of the two the listing includes, since few have both: the LUXOAK and Yoobure list charging, while the Hlivelood lists lights. Outlets near the bed matter too.

faq.q: Are these Murphy beds ready to use?
faq.a: They are described as assembled cabinet designs, but you may still need to anchor and fit them. Check the listing and plan time for installation, and have a helper for the cabinet's weight, since lifting alone risks damage to the walls and the bed.

faq.q: What mistake do studio renters make most?
faq.a: Ignoring the swing-down clearance. The bed needs open floor in front of it, so measure before you choose a LUXOAK or any cabinet bed. Leave extra for a doorway and the swing arc.

faq.q: Is the Hlivelood worth it over the LUXOAK?
faq.a: Only if built-in lighting and a gas strut lift matter. The LUXOAK offers storage and charging at a lower price range, and many renters value those more. Spend on features you will use nightly.

The listings do not state a mattress, so assume you will supply a queen mattress and confirm the thickness limit. A mattress that is too thick may not fold into the cabinet, and a floppy one slumps when upright. Ask the seller for a maximum thickness.

faq.q: Can I use one in a rental?
faq.a: Check your lease, because many cabinet beds need wall anchoring. Ask your landlord before buying, and ask about drilling into studs in writing. A LIVAUVEAD or LUXOAK is only usable if it can be fixed to the wall, so save the lease clause.

faq.q: Do any of these include a desk?
faq.a: No. None of these cabinets includes a desk, so plan a separate desk or wall-mounted option for your studio, placed out of the swing-down path, such as on an adjacent wall.

finalTake: Buy the LUXOAK for a studio that needs the bed to double as a wardrobe wall. Choose the AMERLIFE if the LUXOAK is out of stock, the Yoobure for a rattan look, and the LIVAUVEAD for a low-priced white cabinet. Take the Hlivelood only for built-in lighting and a gas strut lift. Measure swing-down clearance before you compare finishes.
